## Half Ogre (CR 1)

**XP** 400  
CE Medium humanoid (giant)  
**Init** +0; **Senses** darkvision 60 ft.; Perception +0  


**Defense**


**AC** 15, touch 10, flat-footed 15 (+3 armor, +2 natural)

**Fort** +5; **Ref** +0; **Will** +0  


**Offense**
